description: This file contains a Java class named DeleteInteropIdentifierHandler, which handles DELETE operations for interoperability identifiers within the Apache Fineract project. It utilizes Spring annotations for service and transaction management, and implements functionality to process deletion commands based on URL parsing.

classes.name: DeleteInteropIdentifierHandler
classes.description: A Spring service that handles the deletion of interoperability identifiers based on incoming commands by parsing URL segments and invoking the corresponding service method.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a deletion command by parsing the URL, extracting identifier type, ID, and sub-identifier, then delegating the deletion to the interopService.
